title: Personal Loans Refinance-Purpose Quotes: Holding an Additional-Principal Payment That Could Still Be Returned
content:
## Rule

An additional-principal payment on a Personal Loans loan that could still come back is held on a refinance-purpose payoff quote, looking at the latest payment of type additional principal on the loan (on a tie of dates, the first one recorded):

- when that payment was made by online ACH, has not been returned, and a payment on the loan was returned fewer than 12 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the quote date, its hold runs 10 days;
- when that payment was made by online ACH, has not been returned, and no payment on the loan was returned in those 12 months, its hold runs 5 days;
- when that payment was not made by online ACH, has already been returned (its return has already restored it to the loan), or there is none, nothing is held.

A payment on hold, one whose effective date is fewer days before the quote date (a count of days between two dates being the later date minus the earlier) than its hold runs, has its whole amount added back to the payoff amount. The amount added back is added after the quoted interest is worked out and earns no quoted interest.

## Hold by record

| Latest additional-principal payment | Return on the loan in the 12 whole months before | Hold |
|---|---|---|
| online ACH, not returned | yes | 10 days |
| online ACH, not returned | no | 5 days |
| online ACH, already returned | any | nothing held |
| debit card, mailed check or any channel other than online ACH | any | nothing held |
| none on the loan | any | nothing held |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, quote on 20 August)

| Payment effective | Days before the quote | 5-day hold | 10-day hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 August | 4 | held | held |
| 15 August | 5 | not held | held |
| 11 August | 9 | not held | held |
| 10 August | 10 | not held | not held |

A held payment of 500.00 USD adds 500.00 to the payoff amount, with no interest on it.
